key.name: macros
key.description: All macros, steps and conditions, serialised as JSON

key.name: active-macro-id
key.description: Id of the macro whose row is selected — where recordings land

key.name: running-steps
key.description: Internal: JSON, per running macro, of the step ids its runner is inside

key.name: record-into
key.description: The selected row, as "after:stepId", "in:stepId:branch" or "end:macroId"

key.name: recording
key.description: Internal: "macro", "capture", or empty when nothing is being recorded

key.name: pick-region-request
key.description: Internal: asks the shell to let you drag out a screen area

key.name: pick-region-result
key.description: Internal: the rectangle the shell captured, as JSON

key.name: pick-point-request
key.description: Internal: asks the shell to wait for a click and report where it landed

key.name: pick-point-result
key.description: Internal: the position the shell captured, as JSON

key.name: capture-step-request
key.description: Internal: JSON naming the macro and list a captured step should go into

key.name: capture-step-result
key.description: Internal: JSON reporting how the last capture went

key.name: record-request
key.description: Internal: JSON asking the shell to start or stop a whole recording

key.name: record-result
key.description: Internal: JSON reporting whether the recording started or stopped

key.name: run-step-request
key.description: Internal: JSON naming a single step the editor wants run right now

key.name: run-step-result
key.description: Internal: JSON reporting how that step went

key.name: run-macro-request
key.description: Internal: JSON naming a macro the editor wants started or stopped

key.name: run-macro-result
key.description: Internal: JSON reporting whether it started

key.name: show-marker-request
key.description: Internal: JSON position or region the shell should flash on screen

key.name: capture-step
key.description: Append the next click or pointer move to the selected macro as a step

key.name: run-macro
key.summary: Run or pause the macros that are switched on
key.description: Starts every macro switched on, or pauses them. With one running, pressing it again continues from the step it paused on; Stop in the panel menu goes back to starting at the top.

key.name: record-toggle
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that toggles recording into the selected macro

key.name: panic-stop
key.description: Abort any running macro and release every held key

key.name: llm-endpoint
key.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint used for screenshot questions

key.name: llm-model
key.description: Model identifier passed to the endpoint

key.name: llm-api-key
key.description: Sent as a bearer token when set; usually empty for local servers

key.name: llm-timeout-ms
key.description: How long to wait for the model before giving up, in milliseconds

key.name: llm-max-width
key.description: Screenshots are scaled down to this width before being sent. Preferences offers the widths of the common resolutions — 1280 is 720p.

key.name: control-socket
key.description: Unix socket the daemon serves its JSON API on

key.name: event-socket
key.description: Unix socket the daemon streams recorded input events on

key.name: record-gap-ms
key.description: Idle gaps longer than this become wait steps; 0 records no pauses
